versions.document:
---
type: requirement
id: sessions-keep-their-messages
kind: behavior
text:
  - Envoy keeps each message of a session until the session reads it.

---
type: requirement
id: a-session-reads-its-messages-in-order
kind: behavior
parent: sessions-keep-their-messages
text:
  - A session reads its messages in the order that Envoy received them.

---
type: requirement
id: a-session-reads-its-messages-in-order
kind: behavior
parent: sessions-keep-their-messages
text:
  - A session reads its messages in the order that their senders wrote them.

---
type: check
id: messages-come-in-the-order-of-their-writes
serves: a-session-reads-its-messages-in-order
subject: code
procedure: program
test:
  runner: go
  selector: github.com/sjawhar/envoy/cmd/listener TestMessagesComeInTheOrderOfTheirWrites
  job: go-checks
claim: Two messages that one sender writes reach the session in the order of the writes.
procedure_text:
  - The program writes two messages from one sender and reads the session.
  - It must find them in the order of the writes.
failing_example:
  - A listener that delivers the newest message first.
